cotester_chat_messages.message:
As a user, I want to enter details into the form fields, verify the Done and Clear actions, and interact with radio button controls.


Part 1: Enter User Information
Steps:


Wait for the visibility of the Full Name field.
Type “DemoFull” in the Full Name field.
Wait for 2 seconds.
Type “DemoFirst” in the First Name field.


Part 2: Validate Form Actions
Steps:


Wait for the visibility of Done keyboard button
Tap on Done button of keyboard.
Wait for the visibility of the Clear button.
Tap on the Clear button.


Part 3: Navigate to Controls
Steps:


Tap on the Controls tab.
Wait for the visibility of the Male option.
Tap on the Female radio button.


Part 4: Open Modal Sheet and Navigate to Detail Screen
Steps:


Tap on the Screens tab.
Wait for the visibility of Open Modal Sheet.
Tap on Open Modal Sheet.
Wait for the visibility of the Close button.
Swipe down on the screen to dismiss the modal sheet.


Part 5: Navigate Through Nested Screen and Return


Wait for the visibility of Open Detail Screen.
Wait for 2 seconds.
Tap on Open Detail Screen.


Part 6: Navigate Through Nested Screen and Return
Steps:


Wait for the visibility of “Push Another Screen” button.
Tap on “Push Another Screen” button.
Wait for the visibility of “Nested Detail” screen.
Tap on the Back navigation button.
Wait for the visibility of “Detail Screen”.
Tap on Back  navigation button.
Wait for 2 seconds.

Test Case: 1

Test Case Title: Enter User Information into Form Fields
Module: User Input Form
Priority: Medium

Preconditions:
- The application is launched and is displaying the form with Full Name and First Name fields.

Test Steps:
1. Wait for the visibility of the Full Name field.
2. Enter “DemoFull” in the Full Name field.
3. Wait for 2 seconds.
4. Enter “DemoFirst” in the First Name field.

Expected Result:
- The Full Name field contains “DemoFull”.
- The First Name field contains “DemoFirst”.

---

Test Case: 2

Test Case Title: Validate Done and Clear Form Actions
Module: User Input Form
Priority: Medium

Preconditions:
- The form fields are visible to the user.
- The keyboard is active.

Test Steps:
1. Wait for the visibility of the Done keyboard button.
2. Tap on the Done button of the keyboard.
3. Wait for the visibility of the Clear button.
4. Tap on the Clear button.

Expected Result:
- The keyboard is dismissed after tapping Done.
- All text fields are cleared after tapping the Clear button.

---

Test Case: 3

Test Case Title: Interact with Radio Button Controls
Module: User Controls
Priority: Medium

Preconditions:
- The form screen is loaded.
- The Controls tab is visible.

Test Steps:
1. Tap on the Controls tab.
2. Wait for the visibility of the Male option.
3. Tap on the Female radio button.

Expected Result:
- The Female radio button is selected.
- The Male radio button is deselected.

---

Test Case: 4

Test Case Title: Open Modal Sheet and Dismiss via Swipe
Module: Modal Sheet
Priority: Low

Preconditions:
- The Screens tab is accessible on the interface.

Test Steps:
1. Tap on the Screens tab.
2. Wait for the visibility of Open Modal Sheet.
3. Tap on Open Modal Sheet.
4. Wait for the visibility of the Close button on the modal sheet.
5. Swipe down on the screen to dismiss the modal sheet.

Expected Result:
- Modal sheet opens upon tapping.
- Modal sheet is dismissed and returns to previous screen upon swiping down.

---

Test Case: 5

Test Case Title: Navigate to Detail Screen from Modal Sheet Section
Module: Nested Navigation
Priority: Medium

Preconditions:
- The modal sheet has been dismissed and Screens tab is active.

Test Steps:
1. Wait for the visibility of Open Detail Screen.
2. Wait for 2 seconds.
3. Tap on Open Detail Screen.

Expected Result:
- Detail Screen opens successfully after tapping on Open Detail Screen.

---

Test Case: 6

Test Case Title: Navigate Through Nested Screens and Return to Main Screen
Module: Nested Navigation
Priority: Medium

Preconditions:
- The Detail Screen is currently displayed.

Test Steps:
1. Wait for the visibility of the “Push Another Screen” button.
2. Tap on “Push Another Screen” button.
3. Wait for the visibility of “Nested Detail” screen.
4. Tap on the Back navigation button.
5. Wait for the visibility of “Detail Screen”.
6. Tap on Back navigation button.
7. Wait for 2 seconds.
8. Tap on the Form tab.

Expected Result:
- Nested Detail screen is displayed upon pushing.
- Navigating back returns to Detail Screen first, then to the main screen.
- User is returned to the Form tab after navigating back.
